name: HD-BET
summary: Extracts the brain from a T1-weighted image with the HD-BET neural network, outputting the skull-stripped T1w and a binary brain mask.
description: Runs the hd-bet command from MIC-DKFZ/HD-BET on the T1w image, using an NVIDIA GPU when one is available and the CPU otherwise. Fast mode uses one model; accurate mode uses five models with a majority vote, and test-time augmentation adds mirrored inputs. Use it as a deep-learning alternative to FSL BET for skull stripping. The repository README gives no further documentation.

outputs.description: Binary brain mask predicted by HD-BET.

parameters.description: Testing-time augmentation: mirror the input image on the three axes and infer the brain mask on the original & the three new images, taking the majority decision for each voxel for the final output.

options.label: Accurate
options.description: Uses five models to infer the brain mask, taking the majority decision for each voxel for the final output

options.label: Fast
options.description: Uses one model to infer the brain mask.
